BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to discrimination in public schools; and adding anew section to chapter 28A.640 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.640RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The office of the superintendent of public instruction shall haveauthority to review, process, and refer appropriate complaints fromvictims of discrimination in public schools based on state lawsprohibiting discrimination including sex, race, creed, color, nationalorigin, marital status, sexual orientation as defined in RCW 49.60.040,age, or the presence of any sensory, mental, or physical disability orthe use of a trained dog guide or service animal by a person with adisability, as well as federal laws prohibiting discriminationincluding Title VI of the civil rights act of 1964, as amended (42U.S.C. Secs. 2000d et seq.), Title IX of the education amendments of1972, as amended (20 U.S.C. Secs. 1681 et seq.), section 504 of therehabilitation act of 1973, as amended (29 U.S.C. Sec. 794), the agediscrimination act of 1975, as amended (42 U.S.C. Secs. 6101 et seq.),and the boy scouts of America equal access act of 2001 (20 U.S.C. Sec. p. 1 SSB 68007905). Complaints referred by the office of the superintendent ofpublic instruction shall be submitted to the appropriate state orfederal investigative and enforcement agency.
